news.title: 【忘却前夜】超低配置3-5 阿拉克涅一带三 无专钥 可抄作业 7.20融灾
news.summary:
-
  └ 寂榕 (1赞): 太暴力了[doge]
  └ 上好佳薯片丶 (1赞): 本期融灾3-5超低配置可抄作业：阿拉克涅一带三
[无限暖暖_毛线汪汪]配队和最低要求：阿拉克涅（至少70级，3+3，带自己专sr，有一套精通主属性的入药，以下简称alkn）、艾瑞卡（有这个人就行，可以换成其他银钥位）、莉兹（有这个人就行，以下简称栗子）、奥瑞塔（有这个人就行，以下简称水母）。钥令带重逢心愿，能给罗网轮转最好，考虑到萌新打不过星辰篇第五章或者425大佬把钥令留给其他队了，重逢心愿是最佳替代，一轮牌库可以出四张织造。
[无限暖暖_毛线汪汪]操作流程：凹一个alkn织造在手上的落地，所有回合尽量是织造起手。
1.1t觉醒alkn，出织造出蛛丝，出阿拉克涅打防，出银钥位的牌，把阿拉克涅的3费和栗子绿炎留在手上，切静海抗一刀。
2.2t重逢心愿把织造拿回来，出织造出蛛丝，没银钥就跳过。其他流程和1t一样。
3.3t，重逢心愿，把织造拿回来，出织造出蛛丝，湮灭拿织造，阿拉克涅开大，双发带奇点信标的织造把小怪秒掉，出俩蛛丝，然后开始追击，优先出银钥位的牌，从费用高出到费用低，水母0费随便扔，最后丢栗子绿炎，触发满5层蛛丝，切静海，结束回合。
4.4t依旧跟1t一样，有重逢心愿就把织造拿回来出掉，出蛛丝。
5.5t，空间外重逢心愿织造，出两张alkn3费用，有织造再打一张没有就跳过，蛛丝全都不打弃掉回狂，出银钥位置的牌，绿炎保留；空间内打织造全部打光，斩掉boss一条血，之后观察阿拉克涅的狂气情况，留出6t能开大的蜘蛛丝，其他蜘蛛丝出掉，出掉空间里其他有起点信标的牌，切静海。
6.6t跟3t一样，重逢心愿接织造，湮灭alkn开大，双发织造之后开始追击，追击一下一只小怪，结束战斗。
[无限暖暖_毛线汪汪]原理：
1.3-5是异变体，alkn专攻可以逃课。
2.栗子绿炎有保留且可以不消耗费用出，水母有0费，这俩人可以完美触发完追击。
[无限暖暖_毛线汪汪]叠甲：如果流程跟我的有大出入，大概率是阿拉克涅的角色等级低了、技能等级低了、阿拉克涅自己带的精通少了、队伍强效少了。根据自己队伍的实际情况调整一下，尽量别爆死抗，因为这个队伍最重要的就是保血，有血才能转的动追击。

news.title: A critically underrated gem.
news.summary:
Morimens is a gem. I’d go as far to say it’s one of the best gacha games out there for gacha gamers who want something more than just run-of-the-mill waifu collectors.

This game is hard as nails. It has countless grotesque, terrifying, Lovecraftian scenes. The number of people who beat the story’s hard mode is in the double digits. It will grind you up to dust and spit you out.

Yet, I keep coming back to it like a drug.

It’s a card battler that plays a lot like Slay the Spire. It has a steampunk aesthetic. So why is it so addictive?

It’s simple- it’s a roguelite that you have endless variety with, with so many bosses and lovely gimmicks. When you have a boss standing over you with over a thousand health and an attack that can one-shot you, you only have one option- see what you can do to get out of this.

If you want a hidden gem that’s so satisfying to play, Morimens won’t disappoint.

news.title: 2 month player: gacha discussion
news.summary:
I rate this game’s gacha at 7.6/ 10. Monthly pull income for f2p is around 100 limited pulls (3-5 characters average), not including Certain events that give you 250 free pulls.

Someone said it was locked behind a paywall. Which the OTHER 250 pulls are, not this set of 250. 

I now have 5 functional teams after two months. 

I still have zero clue why someone said 500 bucks for an event?? 😭 I’m being so fr where in the Milky Way is this event??

Warning because this is where the game boils down to personal preference.

EVERY. SINGLE. Character. is capable of being good. Someone is labeled B tier? That means the character is GREAT. But you must  have a foggy idea of what kind of dps you want to build around. Banners are unpredictable because they tend to be gone for a few months, so you are limited to several dps upon starting, such as great standard characters or dps in reruns. 

You MUST use your brain. Chaos Zero Nightmare is easier. Here, I was already thinking on the tutorial. Auto battle is genuinely stupid- it just plays all of your cards in no order brainlessly. This is why I’ve stuck with the game though. Autoing stuff always kills my love for beautiful games.

Great art, but no animations. Understandable since this game doesn’t have many funds. 

There is a single gooner character (and she has a gooner equipment card 😭) but it doesn’t distract from the atmosphere at all imo. Also more male characters than certain games…

Problem is there’s a PvP/tcg thing. I despise PvP AND tcg so great combo there, I will be forever missing out on the 150 pulls. Why did they have to make that one part of the game actually contain noticeable materials…
